2026_04_IND_WAS.headline: London trip puts Colts’ ball security against Washington’s changing lineup
2026_04_IND_WAS.paragraph1: Indianapolis arrives in London after beating Houston despite losing the turnover battle, making Daniel Jones’ ball security a central issue against Washington. The Commanders are also coming off their first win, but their travel week includes lineup uncertainty around Jayden Daniels while Marcus Mariota remains the alternative at quarterback. Washington’s depth chart also puts Terry McLaurin and Stefon Diggs atop the receiving group. Handling the overseas routine, quarterback decisions and explosive-play prevention should decide which offense settles first.
2026_04_IND_WAS.model_rationale: Indianapolis has the steadier immediate quarterback setup, but Washington’s receiving talent can punish coverage errors; possession discipline and adaptation to the London setting are the central matchup variables.
